newsitem.title: USA: US Airways lowers advance purchase fares.
newsitem.headline: US Airways lowers advance purchase fares.

text.p: US Airways Group Inc said Wednesday it lowered seven-day and 14-day advance purchase round-trip ticket fares for certain markets, with prices ranging from $198 to $518.
It said the lowest sale fare requires a 14-day advance purchase and the passenger must travel on Tuesday, Wednesday or Saturday.
Travel must be completed by November 4 and include at least one Friday night stay, it said.
Seven-day round-trip advance purchase fares start at $238, and other discounts are available when travelling night-coach flights, it said.
Some examples of the new fares are: Boston-Los Angeles, $388; Philadelphia-San Francisco, $418; Washington (National)-Phoenix, $358; and New York (LaGuardia)-Columbus, Ohio, $198.
